workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 單顆粒資料集規劃練習：目標是直徑 100 Å、約 300 kDa 的蛋白質做到 3 Å，300 kV、λ = 0.0197 Å。像素取 0.9 Å（Nyquist 1.8 Å，留 1.7 倍餘裕）；離焦範圍 0.8 到 2.0 µm，1.5 µm 時第一零點 17.2 Å、3 Å 前有 33 個零點，離焦容差 11 nm 靠逐張 CTF 擬合達成。總劑量 40 e⁻/Å² 分 40 幀，前 11 e⁻/Å² 承載 3 Å 資訊，其餘以劑量加權壓低；偵測器劑量率 40×0.9²/8 ≈ 4 e⁻/像素/s。Ewald 極限 √(0.0197×100) ≈ 1.4 Å，3 Å 不需修正。顆粒數：以 B = 100 Å² 與 4 Å 需 2 萬顆推算，3 Å 需 2 萬×11.4 ≈ 23 萬顆；每部電影 150 顆 → 1520 部；每部 12 s → 約 5 小時；原始資料 1520×1.34 GB ≈ 2 TB。冰厚 100 nm 時 22% 電子非彈性散射，若能做到 50 nm 則 12%，顆粒對比提升約 1.5 倍、所需顆粒數可降一半。數值為教學假設，不代表任何儀器或設施規格。
workedExample.textEn: Single-particle dataset planning exercise: target 3 Å for a 100 Å, roughly 300 kDa protein at 300 kV with λ = 0.0197 Å. Pixel 0.9 Å (Nyquist 1.8 Å, 1.7-fold margin); defocus range 0.8 to 2.0 µm, where at 1.5 µm the first zero is 17.2 Å with 33 zeros before 3 Å and the 11 nm defocus tolerance is met by per-image CTF fitting. Total dose 40 e⁻/Å² in 40 frames, the first 11 e⁻/Å² carrying the 3 Å information and the rest down-weighted; detector dose rate 40×0.9²/8 ≈ 4 e⁻/pixel/s. Ewald limit √(0.0197×100) ≈ 1.4 Å, so no correction at 3 Å. Particle count: with B = 100 Å² and 20,000 particles needed for 4 Å, 3 Å needs 20,000×11.4 ≈ 230,000; at 150 per movie → 1520 movies; at 12 s each → about 5 hours; raw data 1520×1.34 GB ≈ 2 TB. With 100 nm ice 22% of electrons scatter inelastically; at 50 nm only 12%, raising particle contrast about 1.5-fold and roughly halving the particles needed. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's or facility's specification.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.

steps.title: 玻璃化、輻射損傷與低劑量成像：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Vitrification, radiation damage and low-dose imaging: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「玻璃態冰與劑量預算」如何決定低溫電子顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vitreous ice and the dose budget” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic electron microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 生物分子只有在水環境中才保持結構，但顯微鏡在真空中工作，所以把含水樣品以每秒十萬度的速率急凍成玻璃態冰：水分子來不及結晶，分子被原位固定，低溫同時減緩電子束造成的自由基擴散。即使如此，每個電子穿過樣品都會沉積能量，高解析資訊在幾個電子每平方埃之後就消失，所以每張影像的總劑量被限制在數十 e⁻/Å²，影像極度缺乏訊號，必須靠平均成千上萬個相同顆粒把訊噪比補回來。劑量也要分配成多幀電影，讓後段處理能依每幀累積劑量加權。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「玻璃態冰與劑量預算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Biological molecules keep their structure only in water, yet the microscope works in vacuum, so hydrated specimens are frozen at about 10⁵ K/s into vitreous ice: water has no time to crystallise, molecules are fixed in place, and the low temperature slows radical diffusion caused by the beam. Even so, every electron deposits energy, high-resolution information vanishes after a few electrons per square ångström, and the total dose per image is capped at tens of e⁻/Å², leaving images starved of signal that only averaging tens of thousands of identical particles can recover. The dose is also split into a multi-frame movie so later processing can weight each frame by its accumulated exposure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Vitreous ice and the dose budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：玻璃化：從 4 °C 冷到約 −137 °C 的去玻璃化溫度以下需降溫 141 K，在 1.4 ms 內完成即約 10⁵ K/s，液態乙烷（−183 °C）的高熱傳率是關鍵。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Vitrification: cooling from 4 °C to below the roughly −137 °C devitrification temperature is 141 K, and doing it within 1.4 ms is about 10⁵ K/s, which is why the high heat-transfer rate of liquid ethane (−183 °C) matters.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「低溫只是為了讓樣品在真空中不蒸發。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low temperature serves only to stop the specimen evaporating in vacuum." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「玻璃態冰與劑量預算」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Vitreous ice and the dose budget”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「玻璃化、輻射損傷與低劑量成像」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Vitrification, radiation damage and low-dose imaging" is correct?
options: 低溫只是為了讓樣品在真空中不蒸發。
生物分子只有在水環境中才保持結構，但顯微鏡在真空中工作，所以把含水樣品以每秒十萬度的速率急凍成玻璃態冰：水分子來不及結晶，分子被原位固定，低溫同時減緩電子束造成的自由基擴散。
離焦越大影像越清楚，所以重建解析度也越高。
optionsEn: Low temperature serves only to stop the specimen evaporating in vacuum.

Larger defocus gives clearer images and therefore higher reconstruction resolution.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 玻璃化、輻射損傷與低劑量成像：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Vitrification, radiation damage and low-dose imaging: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「玻璃態冰與劑量預算」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vitreous ice and the dose budget” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：玻璃化：從 4 °C 冷到約 −137 °C 的去玻璃化溫度以下需降溫 141 K，在 1.4 ms 內完成即約 10⁵ K/s，液態乙烷（−183 °C）的高熱傳率是關鍵。Grant–Grigorieff 臨界曝光 N_e(k) ≈ 0.245·k^−1.665 + 2.81 e⁻/Å²（k 為空間頻率，Å⁻¹）：2 Å 時 3.6、3 Å 時 4.3、10 Å 時 14 e⁻/Å²；最佳累積曝光約為臨界值的 2.5 倍，所以 3 Å 的資訊在前 11 e⁻/Å² 內最有價值，總劑量 40 e⁻/Å² 的後段主要貢獻低解析對比。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Vitrification: cooling from 4 °C to below the roughly −137 °C devitrification temperature is 141 K, and doing it within 1.4 ms is about 10⁵ K/s, which is why the high heat-transfer rate of liquid ethane (−183 °C) matters. Grant–Grigorieff critical exposure N_e(k) ≈ 0.245·k^−1.665 + 2.81 e⁻/Å² with k the spatial frequency in Å⁻¹: 3.6 at 2 Å, 4.3 at 3 Å, 14 e⁻/Å² at 10 Å; the optimum accumulated exposure is about 2.5 times the critical value, so 3 Å information is most valuable within the first 11 e⁻/Å² and the later part of a 40 e⁻/Å² exposure mainly contributes low-resolution contrast. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同一冰區以固定劑量率拍 60 幀電影，對每幀的傅立葉功率譜量各空間頻率的訊號衰減，擬合指數衰減常數與 Grant–Grigorieff 曲線比較；以電子繞射觀察冰是否出現六方或立方冰的繞射環，確認玻璃化成功且在搬運中沒有超過 −137 °C。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record a 60-frame movie at fixed dose rate on one ice area, measure the signal decay at each spatial frequency from per-frame power spectra and fit decay constants against the Grant–Grigorieff curve; use electron diffraction to check for hexagonal or cubic ice rings, confirming successful vitrification and that −137 °C was never exceeded during transfer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

Grant–Grigorieff critical exposure N_e(k) ≈ 0.245·k^−1.665 + 2.81 e⁻/Å² with k the spatial frequency in Å⁻¹: 3.6 at 2 Å, 4.3 at 3 Å, 14 e⁻/Å² at 10 Å; the optimum accumulated exposure is about 2.5 times the critical value, so 3 Å information is most valuable within the first 11 e⁻/Å² and the later part of a 40 e⁻/Å² exposure mainly contributes low-resolution contrast.

quiz.question: 依「玻璃化、輻射損傷與低劑量成像」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Vitrification, radiation damage and low-dose imaging", which statement holds?
options: 樣品已經在真空裡，所以不會再被污染。
顆粒越大訊號越強，所以大顆粒總是更容易做到高解析度。

optionsEn: Once in vacuum the specimen can no longer be contaminated.
Larger particles give more signal and are therefore always easier to push to high resolution.

Vitrification: cooling from 4 °C to below the roughly −137 °C devitrification temperature is 141 K, and doing it within 1.4 ms is about 10⁵ K/s, which is why the high heat-transfer rate of liquid ethane (−183 °C) matters.

quiz.explanationEn: Vitrification: cooling from 4 °C to below the roughly −137 °C devitrification temperature is 141 K, and doing it within 1.4 ms is about 10⁵ K/s, which is why the high heat-transfer rate of liquid ethane (−183 °C) matters. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 玻璃化、輻射損傷與低劑量成像：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Vitrification, radiation damage and low-dose imaging: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「玻璃態冰與劑量預算」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Vitreous ice and the dose budget” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在同一冰區以固定劑量率拍 60 幀電影，對每幀的傅立葉功率譜量各空間頻率的訊號衰減，擬合指數衰減常數與 Grant–Grigorieff 曲線比較；以電子繞射觀察冰是否出現六方或立方冰的繞射環，確認玻璃化成功且在搬運中沒有超過 −137 °C。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record a 60-frame movie at fixed dose rate on one ice area, measure the signal decay at each spatial frequency from per-frame power spectra and fit decay constants against the Grant–Grigorieff curve; use electron diffraction to check for hexagonal or cubic ice rings, confirming successful vitrification and that −137 °C was never exceeded during transfer. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：轉移樣品時冷卻鉗短暫離開液氮，網格升溫超過 −137 °C，玻璃態冰轉成立方冰，顆粒被擠壓變形且背景出現繞射環，整批網格資料不可用而且往往在收完數千張影像後才發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Tweezers leaving liquid nitrogen briefly during transfer let the grid warm above −137 °C, vitreous ice turns cubic, particles are crushed and diffraction rings appear in the background; the whole grid's data are unusable, often discovered only after thousands of images are collected.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 在同一冰區以固定劑量率拍 60 幀電影，對每幀的傅立葉功率譜量各空間頻率的訊號衰減，擬合指數衰減常數與 Grant–Grigorieff 曲線比較；以電子繞射觀察冰是否出現六方或立方冰的繞射環，確認玻璃化成功且在搬運中沒有超過 −137 °C。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「玻璃化、輻射損傷與低劑量成像」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Vitrification, radiation damage and low-dose imaging"?
options: 在同一冰區以固定劑量率拍 60 幀電影，對每幀的傅立葉功率譜量各空間頻率的訊號衰減，擬合指數衰減常數與 Grant–Grigorieff 曲線比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
顯微鏡本身的解析度決定一切，資料管線只是附屬設備。
optionsEn: Record a 60-frame movie at fixed dose rate on one ice area, measure the signal decay at each spatial frequency from per-frame power spectra and fit decay constants against the Grant–Grigorieff curve.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The microscope's own resolution decides everything and the data pipeline is auxiliary equipment.
quiz.explanation: 在同一冰區以固定劑量率拍 60 幀電影，對每幀的傅立葉功率譜量各空間頻率的訊號衰減，擬合指數衰減常數與 Grant–Grigorieff 曲線比較；以電子繞射觀察冰是否出現六方或立方冰的繞射環，確認玻璃化成功且在搬運中沒有超過 −137 °C。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record a 60-frame movie at fixed dose rate on one ice area, measure the signal decay at each spatial frequency from per-frame power spectra and fit decay constants against the Grant–Grigorieff curve; use electron diffraction to check for hexagonal or cubic ice rings, confirming successful vitrification and that −137 °C was never exceeded during transfer. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 玻璃化、輻射損傷與低劑量成像：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Vitrification, radiation damage and low-dose imaging: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「玻璃態冰與劑量預算」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Vitreous ice and the dose budget” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 轉移樣品時冷卻鉗短暫離開液氮，網格升溫超過 −137 °C，玻璃態冰轉成立方冰，顆粒被擠壓變形且背景出現繞射環，整批網格資料不可用而且往往在收完數千張影像後才發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Tweezers leaving liquid nitrogen briefly during transfer let the grid warm above −137 °C, vitreous ice turns cubic, particles are crushed and diffraction rings appear in the background; the whole grid's data are unusable, often discovered only after thousands of images are collected. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：劑量也要分配成多幀電影，讓後段處理能依每幀累積劑量加權。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The dose is also split into a multi-frame movie so later processing can weight each frame by its accumulated exposure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「低溫只是為了讓樣品在真空中不蒸發。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low temperature serves only to stop the specimen evaporating in vacuum." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「玻璃化、輻射損傷與低劑量成像」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Vitrification, radiation damage and low-dose imaging" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
轉移樣品時冷卻鉗短暫離開液氮，網格升溫超過 −137 °C，玻璃態冰轉成立方冰，顆粒被擠壓變形且背景出現繞射環，整批網格資料不可用而且往往在收完數千張影像後才發現。
離焦越大影像越清楚，所以重建解析度也越高。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Tweezers leaving liquid nitrogen briefly during transfer let the grid warm above −137 °C, vitreous ice turns cubic, particles are crushed and diffraction rings appear in the background.
Larger defocus gives clearer images and therefore higher reconstruction resolution.
quiz.explanation: 轉移樣品時冷卻鉗短暫離開液氮，網格升溫超過 −137 °C，玻璃態冰轉成立方冰，顆粒被擠壓變形且背景出現繞射環，整批網格資料不可用而且往往在收完數千張影像後才發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Tweezers leaving liquid nitrogen briefly during transfer let the grid warm above −137 °C, vitreous ice turns cubic, particles are crushed and diffraction rings appear in the background; the whole grid's data are unusable, often discovered only after thousands of images are collected. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 弱相位物體、離焦與對比傳遞函數：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Weak phase objects, defocus and the contrast transfer function: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「離焦相位對比與 CTF 零點」如何決定低溫電子顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Defocus phase contrast and CTF zeros” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic electron microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 蛋白質在冰中幾乎不吸收電子，只改變穿透波的相位，正焦時影像幾乎沒有對比；把物鏡調到 1 到 3 µm 的欠焦，相位差經由 sin χ(u) 轉成強度對比，χ(u) = πλΔf·u² − (π/2)·C_s·λ³·u⁴。離焦越大，低頻對比越強、顆粒越容易辨認，但 CTF 的第一個零點越早出現，之後正負交替的傳遞必須在後處理中依每張影像擬合的離焦與像散做相位翻轉或 Wiener 修正，而且離焦必須量得夠準，否則高頻相位會被錯誤翻轉。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「離焦相位對比與 CTF 零點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Proteins in ice barely absorb electrons and only shift the phase of the transmitted wave, so an in-focus image has almost no contrast; underfocusing the objective by 1 to 3 µm converts phase into intensity through sin χ(u), with χ(u) = πλΔf·u² − (π/2)·C_s·λ³·u⁴. Larger defocus strengthens low-frequency contrast and makes particles easier to see, but the first CTF zero arrives earlier, and the alternating transfer beyond it must be phase-flipped or Wiener-corrected in processing using defocus and astigmatism fitted per image; the defocus must be known accurately or high-frequency phases are flipped the wrong way. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Defocus phase contrast and CTF zeros”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：忽略 C_s 時第一零點在 u₁ = 1/√(λΔf)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Ignoring C_s the first zero lies at u₁ = 1/√(λΔf).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「離焦越大影像越清楚，所以重建解析度也越高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Larger defocus gives clearer images and therefore higher reconstruction resolution." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「離焦相位對比與 CTF 零點」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Defocus phase contrast and CTF zeros”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：離焦越大影像越清楚，所以重建解析度也越高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「弱相位物體、離焦與對比傳遞函數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Weak phase objects, defocus and the contrast transfer function" is correct?
options: 離焦越大影像越清楚，所以重建解析度也越高。
冰越薄越好，所以吸附時間應該越長越好。
蛋白質在冰中幾乎不吸收電子，只改變穿透波的相位，正焦時影像幾乎沒有對比。
optionsEn: Larger defocus gives clearer images and therefore higher reconstruction resolution.
Thinner ice is always better, so blotting should be as long as possible.
Proteins in ice barely absorb electrons and only shift the phase of the transmitted wave, so an in-focus image has almost no contrast.
quiz.explanation: 蛋白質在冰中幾乎不吸收電子，只改變穿透波的相位，正焦時影像幾乎沒有對比；把物鏡調到 1 到 3 µm 的欠焦，相位差經由 sin χ(u) 轉成強度對比，χ(u) = πλΔf·u² − (π/2)·C_s·λ³·u⁴。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Proteins in ice barely absorb electrons and only shift the phase of the transmitted wave, so an in-focus image has almost no contrast; underfocusing the objective by 1 to 3 µm converts phase into intensity through sin χ(u), with χ(u) = πλΔf·u² − (π/2)·C_s·λ³·u⁴. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 弱相位物體、離焦與對比傳遞函數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Weak phase objects, defocus and the contrast transfer function: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「離焦相位對比與 CTF 零點」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Defocus phase contrast and CTF zeros” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：忽略 C_s 時第一零點在 u₁ = 1/√(λΔf)。300 kV、λ = 0.0197 Å：Δf = 0.5 µm 時 9.9 Å，1.5 µm 時 17.2 Å，2.5 µm 時 22.2 Å。到 3 Å 之前的零點數 ≈ λΔf·u² = 0.0197×15000×(1/3)² ≈ 33 個（1.5 µm）。離焦容差：要在 3 Å 保持相位誤差 < π/4，δf < 1/(4λu²) ≈ 114 Å ≈ 11 nm；2 Å 時收緊到 5 nm，所以逐張甚至逐顆粒的 CTF 精修是必要的。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Ignoring C_s the first zero lies at u₁ = 1/√(λΔf). At 300 kV with λ = 0.0197 Å: 9.9 Å at Δf = 0.5 µm, 17.2 Å at 1.5 µm, 22.2 Å at 2.5 µm. The number of zeros before 3 Å is ≈ λΔf·u² = 0.0197×15000×(1/3)² ≈ 33 at 1.5 µm. Defocus tolerance: keeping the phase error below π/4 at 3 Å needs δf < 1/(4λu²) ≈ 114 Å ≈ 11 nm, tightening to 5 nm at 2 Å, which is why per-image and even per-particle CTF refinement is necessary. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對每張顯微影像計算旋轉平均功率譜並擬合 Thon 環，得到離焦、像散與擬合可信的最高頻率；把擬合的離焦與顯微鏡回報的離焦相比，系統性偏差反映物鏡電流與高度校正；用碳膜區的 Thon 環檢查零點位置是否與 1/√(λΔf) 一致，並確認像散小於 50 nm。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the rotationally averaged power spectrum of each micrograph and fit Thon rings to obtain defocus, astigmatism and the highest frequency at which the fit is credible; compare the fitted defocus with the microscope's reported value, where a systematic offset reflects objective-current and eucentric-height calibration; check on carbon-film areas that the zero positions agree with 1/√(λΔf) and that astigmatism is below 50 nm.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Weak phase objects, defocus and the contrast transfer function", which statement holds?

steps.title: 弱相位物體、離焦與對比傳遞函數：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Weak phase objects, defocus and the contrast transfer function: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「離焦相位對比與 CTF 零點」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Defocus phase contrast and CTF zeros” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對每張顯微影像計算旋轉平均功率譜並擬合 Thon 環，得到離焦、像散與擬合可信的最高頻率；把擬合的離焦與顯微鏡回報的離焦相比，系統性偏差反映物鏡電流與高度校正；用碳膜區的 Thon 環檢查零點位置是否與 1/√(λΔf) 一致，並確認像散小於 50 nm。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute the rotationally averaged power spectrum of each micrograph and fit Thon rings to obtain defocus, astigmatism and the highest frequency at which the fit is credible; compare the fitted defocus with the microscope's reported value, where a systematic offset reflects objective-current and eucentric-height calibration; check on carbon-film areas that the zero positions agree with 1/√(λΔf) and that astigmatism is below 50 nm. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了看清小顆粒把離焦設到 4 µm，第一零點退到 28 Å，到 3 Å 前有近 90 個零點，CTF 擬合在高頻失去可信度，離焦誤差超過 11 nm 的容差，重建在 4 Å 停滯而顆粒數再多也無法改善。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Setting defocus to 4 µm to see small particles pushes the first zero out to 28 Å with nearly 90 zeros before 3 Å; CTF fitting loses credibility at high frequency, the defocus error exceeds the 11 nm tolerance, and the reconstruction stalls at 4 Å no matter how many particles are added.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 樣品製備硬體：急凍、網格與冰厚控制：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Specimen-preparation hardware: plunging, grids and ice-thickness control: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「急凍儀、網格與冰厚」如何決定低溫電子顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Plunge freezer, grids and ice thickness” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic electron microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 製備在溫濕度受控的急凍儀中進行：3 µL 樣品滴在帶孔碳膜或金膜網格上，濾紙吸去多餘液體只留幾十奈米的薄膜，隨即插入液態乙烷。冰厚是最關鍵的製備參數：太厚則背景的非彈性散射淹沒顆粒對比，太薄則顆粒被擠到孔邊或變性在氣液界面。金網格與金箔支撐膜在冷卻時收縮一致，減少束致漂移；塗石墨烯或親水處理用來控制顆粒分佈與取向。冰厚可用能量過濾器由非彈性散射比例估計。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「急凍儀、網格與冰厚」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Preparation happens in a temperature- and humidity-controlled plunge freezer: 3 µL of sample is applied to a holey carbon or gold-film grid, filter paper blots away excess liquid leaving a film tens of nanometres thick, and the grid is plunged into liquid ethane. Ice thickness is the decisive preparation parameter: too thick and inelastic background swamps particle contrast, too thin and particles are pushed to hole edges or denature at the air-water interface. Gold grids with gold-foil supports contract uniformly on cooling and reduce beam-induced motion; graphene coatings or hydrophilic treatments control particle distribution and orientation. Ice thickness can be estimated with an energy filter from the inelastic-scattering fraction. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Plunge freezer, grids and ice thickness”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：300 kV 玻璃態冰的非彈性平均自由徑取約 400 nm（教學假設）：冰厚 50 nm 時 t/λ = 0.125，非彈性比例 1 − exp(−0.125) ≈ 12%；100 nm 時 22%；200 nm 時 39%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Taking an inelastic mean free path of about 400 nm for vitreous ice at 300 kV (teaching assumption): 50 nm of ice gives t/λ = 0.125 and an inelastic fraction 1 − exp(−0.125) ≈ 12%; 100 nm gives 22%; 200 nm gives 39%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「冰越薄越好，所以吸附時間應該越長越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thinner ice is always better, so blotting should be as long as possible." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「急凍儀、網格與冰厚」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「急凍儀、網格與冰厚」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Plunge freezer, grids and ice thickness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：300 kV 玻璃態冰的非彈性平均自由徑取約 400 nm（教學假設）：冰厚 50 nm 時 t/λ = 0.125，非彈性比例 1 − exp(−0.125) ≈ 12%；100 nm 時 22%；200 nm 時 39%。直徑 10 nm 的蛋白質在 100 nm 冰中只占路徑的 10%，其餘 90% 是只貢獻雜訊的水，這就是為何冰厚每減少一半，單顆粒的有效訊噪比明顯提升。急凍冷卻：乙烷熱傳足以讓 100 nm 水膜在 1 ms 內降溫 140 K。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Taking an inelastic mean free path of about 400 nm for vitreous ice at 300 kV (teaching assumption): 50 nm of ice gives t/λ = 0.125 and an inelastic fraction 1 − exp(−0.125) ≈ 12%; 100 nm gives 22%; 200 nm gives 39%. Plunge cooling: ethane heat transfer cools a 100 nm water film by 140 K within 1 ms. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以能量過濾器拍同一孔的零損失與未過濾影像，由強度比算 t/λ 並換成冰厚，建立濕度、吸附時間與冰厚的關係表；以不同吸附時間製備網格，在低倍影像中統計可用孔的比例與顆粒密度，選出重現性最高的參數；對金網格與碳網格各收一組短電影比較前 5 幀的束致漂移量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record zero-loss and unfiltered images of the same hole with the energy filter, compute t/λ from the intensity ratio and convert to ice thickness, building a table relating humidity, blot time and thickness; prepare grids at several blot times, count usable holes and particle density in low-magnification images and pick the most reproducible setting; collect short movies on gold and carbon grids and compare beam-induced motion in the first 5 frames.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：水氣撞擊通量 Φ = p/√(2πmkT)。p = 1×10⁻⁵ Pa、293 K 時 Φ ≈ 3.6×10¹⁷ m⁻² s⁻¹，以 10¹⁹ m⁻² 為一單層、黏附係數 1、每單層 0.3 nm 計，冰以約 40 nm/h 生長，一小時就把 50 nm 的冰厚加倍；冷阱把樣品附近的水氣分壓壓到 1×10⁻⁷ Pa 後為 0.4 nm/h。偵測器取樣：像素 0.8 Å 的 Nyquist 極限為 1.6 Å，目標 3 Å 時像素可放大到 1.0 Å；40 e⁻/Å² 在 8 s 內以 0.9 Å 像素拍攝的偵測器劑量率約 4 e⁻/像素/s，落在計數模式的線性區。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Water impingement flux Φ = p/√(2πmkT). steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Leave an empty grid in the column and measure the same hole's ice thickness by energy filtering every 30 minutes; the slope is the contamination rate, to be correlated with cryo-shield temperature and vacuum-gauge readings; characterise the detector's DQE and modulation transfer function under uniform illumination at several dose rates to find where counting loss begins; centre the energy-filter slit on the zero-loss peak and check its drift daily.

steps.title: 資料收集校正：像素尺度、劑量率與束傾：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Data-collection calibration: pixel scale, dose rate and beam tilt: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「像素尺度、劑量與彗差校正」如何決定低溫電子顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pixel scale, dose and coma-free calibration” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic electron microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重建的絕對尺度來自像素尺寸，錯 1% 就讓整個原子模型縮放 1%，因此用已知結構（例如去鐵蛋白的 2.0 Å 重建或金晶格 2.355 Å）校正，並檢查放大率的方向性差異。劑量率在偵測器上以計數校正，再換算到樣品面；劑量過高進入計數非線性區，過低則浪費時間。束傾使彗差把 CTF 變成非對稱，必須做無彗差對準並在資料處理中精修；自動收集用影像位移在多個孔間移動時會引入束傾，所以需要事先校正像移與束傾的補償關係。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「像素尺度、劑量與彗差校正」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The absolute scale of a reconstruction comes from pixel size, and a 1% error scales the whole atomic model by 1%, so it is calibrated with a known structure (for example a 2.0 Å apoferritin reconstruction or the 2.355 Å gold lattice) and checked for magnification anisotropy. Dose rate is calibrated on the detector in counts and converted to the specimen plane; too high a rate enters counting non-linearity, too low wastes time. Beam tilt introduces coma that makes the CTF asymmetric, so coma-free alignment is performed and refined in processing; automated collection that moves between holes by image shift introduces beam tilt, so the compensation between image shift and beam tilt must be calibrated beforehand. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pixel scale, dose and coma-free calibration”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：像素尺度：以金 (111) 2.355 Å 環校正，若 1.000 Å 像素被量成 1.012 Å，模型的所有距離偏 1.2%，一個 300 Å 的顆粒直徑偏 3.6 Å，比目標解析度 3 Å 還大。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Pixel scale: calibrating on the gold (111) ring at 2.355 Å, if a nominal 1.000 Å pixel measures 1.012 Å every model distance is off by 1.2% and a 300 Å particle diameter errs by 3.6 Å, larger than the 3 Å target resolution.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「顯微鏡設定的放大率就是精確的像素尺寸。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The magnification set on the microscope gives the exact pixel size." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「像素尺度、劑量與彗差校正」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 資料收集校正：像素尺度、劑量率與束傾：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Data-collection calibration: pixel scale, dose rate and beam tilt: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「像素尺度、劑量與彗差校正」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pixel scale, dose and coma-free calibration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：像素尺度：以金 (111) 2.355 Å 環校正，若 1.000 Å 像素被量成 1.012 Å，模型的所有距離偏 1.2%，一個 300 Å 的顆粒直徑偏 3.6 Å，比目標解析度 3 Å 還大。放大率各向異性 0.5% 在 2 Å 重建中造成的位置誤差 0.5%×150 Å = 0.75 Å，需在處理中修正。束傾 1 mrad 在 300 kV 產生的彗差相位誤差 ≈ 2π·C_s·λ²·u³·θ：C_s = 2.7 mm、u = 1/3 Å⁻¹ 時 ≈ 0.7 rad，已接近 π/4 容限的三倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Pixel scale: calibrating on the gold (111) ring at 2.355 Å, if a nominal 1.000 Å pixel measures 1.012 Å every model distance is off by 1.2% and a 300 Å particle diameter errs by 3.6 Å, larger than the 3 Å target resolution. A 0.5% magnification anisotropy in a 2 Å reconstruction displaces positions by 0.5%×150 Å = 0.75 Å and must be corrected in processing. A 1 mrad beam tilt at 300 kV produces a coma phase error ≈ 2π·C_s·λ²·u³·θ: with C_s = 2.7 mm and u = 1/3 Å⁻¹ it is ≈ 0.7 rad, almost three times the π/4 tolerance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次更換放大率或維修後拍金顆粒繞射或去鐵蛋白測試資料，由環半徑或模型擬合反推像素尺寸並記錄；劑量率以偵測器計數對空束的法拉第量測交叉校正；自動收集前在每個像移距離上做無彗差對準並記錄束傾補償表，收集後用處理軟體精修出的束傾殘餘應小於 0.2 mrad。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After every magnification change or service, record gold-particle diffraction or an apoferritin test set, back out pixel size from ring radii or model fitting and log it; cross-calibrate detector counts against a Faraday measurement of the empty beam; before automated collection perform coma-free alignment at each image-shift distance and record the beam-tilt compensation table, and the residual beam tilt refined by processing software afterwards should be below 0.2 mrad.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: Ewald 球修正、束致漂移與高階像差：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Ewald-sphere correction, beam-induced motion and higher-order aberrations: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Ewald 球曲率與束致漂移」如何決定低溫電子顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ewald-sphere curvature and beam-induced motion” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic electron microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 投影近似假設顆粒上下表面的散射在同一平面，實際上繞射發生在半徑 1/λ 的 Ewald 球面上，球面相對於平面的凹陷在高空間頻率與大顆粒時造成上下表面的相位差，必須在重建時依顆粒厚度與離焦做曲率修正。電子束照射的前幾個 e⁻/Å² 會讓冰膜膨脹與翹曲，顆粒在幾埃內移動並旋轉，所以每張電影的幀先做全域與局部對齊，再依劑量加權。再往下是三階以上的像差：三重像散與四階球面像差在 2 Å 以下成為限制，需要以資料本身精修出的像差係數校正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Ewald 球曲率與束致漂移」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The projection approximation assumes scattering from a particle's top and bottom lies in one plane, but diffraction actually occurs on an Ewald sphere of radius 1/λ, whose sag relative to the plane creates a phase difference between the two surfaces at high spatial frequency and for large particles, requiring curvature correction during reconstruction according to particle thickness and defocus. The first few e⁻/Å² of exposure make the ice film expand and buckle, particles move several ångströms and rotate, so each movie's frames are aligned globally and locally and then dose-weighted. Beyond that, third-order and higher aberrations such as threefold astigmatism and fourth-order spherical aberration become limiting below 2 Å and need aberration coefficients refined from the data themselves. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ewald-sphere curvature and beam-induced motion”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 π/2 相位誤差為準，需做 Ewald 修正的解析度 d_E ≈ √(λD)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a π/2 phase-error criterion, the resolution beyond which Ewald correction is needed is d_E ≈ √(λD).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「顆粒越大訊號越強，所以大顆粒總是更容易做到高解析度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Larger particles give more signal and are therefore always easier to push to high resolution." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: Ewald 球修正、束致漂移與高階像差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ewald-sphere correction, beam-induced motion and higher-order aberrations: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Ewald 球曲率與束致漂移」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ewald-sphere curvature and beam-induced motion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 π/2 相位誤差為準，需做 Ewald 修正的解析度 d_E ≈ √(λD)。300 kV、λ = 0.0197 Å：直徑 D = 100 Å 的顆粒 d_E ≈ 1.4 Å，300 Å 時 2.4 Å，1000 Å 的病毒時 4.4 Å；200 kV（λ = 0.0251 Å）對 300 Å 顆粒為 2.7 Å。束致漂移：前 2 幀若移動 2 Å，未對齊時 3 Å 的訊號衰減因子 ≈ exp(−2π²σ²u²)，σ = 1 Å、u = 1/3 時 ≈ 0.11，幾乎全部喪失，對齊後殘餘 0.2 Å 時回到 0.91。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a π/2 phase-error criterion, the resolution beyond which Ewald correction is needed is d_E ≈ √(λD). At 300 kV with λ = 0.0197 Å: a particle of diameter D = 100 Å gives d_E ≈ 1.4 Å, 300 Å gives 2.4 Å, a 1000 Å virus gives 4.4 Å; at 200 kV (λ = 0.0251 Å) a 300 Å particle gives 2.7 Å. Beam-induced motion: if the first 2 frames move 2 Å, the unaligned attenuation of 3 Å signal is ≈ exp(−2π²σ²u²), about 0.11 for σ = 1 Å and u = 1/3, nearly total loss, recovering to 0.91 after alignment leaves 0.2 Å residual. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對大顆粒資料分別以有、無 Ewald 修正重建並比較 FSC 曲線，修正應在 d_E 以下的頻率提升 FSC 且模型與圖的相關改善；對每部電影畫出對齊後的位移軌跡，統計前 5 幀的累積位移並比較不同網格類型；在高解析資料集上精修三重像散與四階球面像差，確認加入後 FSC 在 2.5 Å 以下的改善。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconstruct large-particle data with and without Ewald correction and compare FSC curves, expecting the correction to raise FSC below d_E and improve model-to-map correlation; plot aligned motion trajectories for every movie, tabulate cumulative displacement over the first 5 frames and compare grid types; on a high-resolution set refine threefold astigmatism and fourth-order spherical aberration and confirm the FSC gain below 2.5 Å.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 π/2 相位誤差為準，需做 Ewald 修正的解析度 d_E ≈ √(λD)。300 kV、λ = 0.0197 Å：直徑 D = 100 Å 的顆粒 d_E ≈ 1.4 Å，300 Å 時 2.4 Å，1000 Å 的病毒時 4.4 Å；200 kV（λ = 0.0251 Å）對 300 Å 顆粒為 2.7 Å。束致漂移：前 2 幀若移動 2 Å，未對齊時 3 Å 的訊號衰減因子 ≈ exp(−2π²σ²u²)，σ = 1 Å、u = 1/3 時 ≈ 0.11，幾乎全部喪失，對齊後殘餘 0.2 Å 時回到 0.91。
knowledge.textEn: With a π/2 phase-error criterion, the resolution beyond which Ewald correction is needed is d_E ≈ √(λD). At 300 kV with λ = 0.0197 Å: a particle of diameter D = 100 Å gives d_E ≈ 1.4 Å, 300 Å gives 2.4 Å, a 1000 Å virus gives 4.4 Å; at 200 kV (λ = 0.0251 Å) a 300 Å particle gives 2.7 Å. Beam-induced motion: if the first 2 frames move 2 Å, the unaligned attenuation of 3 Å signal is ≈ exp(−2π²σ²u²), about 0.11 for σ = 1 Å and u = 1/3, nearly total loss, recovering to 0.91 after alignment leaves 0.2 Å residual.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

steps.title: Ewald 球修正、束致漂移與高階像差：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ewald-sphere correction, beam-induced motion and higher-order aberrations: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「Ewald 球曲率與束致漂移」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Ewald-sphere curvature and beam-induced motion” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對大顆粒資料分別以有、無 Ewald 修正重建並比較 FSC 曲線，修正應在 d_E 以下的頻率提升 FSC 且模型與圖的相關改善；對每部電影畫出對齊後的位移軌跡，統計前 5 幀的累積位移並比較不同網格類型；在高解析資料集上精修三重像散與四階球面像差，確認加入後 FSC 在 2.5 Å 以下的改善。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct large-particle data with and without Ewald correction and compare FSC curves, expecting the correction to raise FSC below d_E and improve model-to-map correlation; plot aligned motion trajectories for every movie, tabulate cumulative displacement over the first 5 frames and compare grid types; on a high-resolution set refine threefold astigmatism and fourth-order spherical aberration and confirm the FSC gain below 2.5 Å. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：對直徑 700 Å 的病毒做到 3 Å 卻未做 Ewald 修正，上下半球的相位互相抵消，圖在 3.7 Å 以後出現虛假的衰減，分析者把它歸咎於冰厚並重新製備樣品，浪費兩輪顯微鏡時間。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Pushing a 700 Å virus to 3 Å without Ewald correction lets the two hemispheres' phases cancel, the map shows false attenuation beyond 3.7 Å, and the analyst blames ice thickness and re-prepares specimens, wasting two rounds of microscope time.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「Ewald 球修正、束致漂移與高階像差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: Ewald 球修正、束致漂移與高階像差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ewald-sphere correction, beam-induced motion and higher-order aberrations: failure diagnosis

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Ewald-sphere curvature and beam-induced motion” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 對直徑 700 Å 的病毒做到 3 Å 卻未做 Ewald 修正，上下半球的相位互相抵消，圖在 3.7 Å 以後出現虛假的衰減，分析者把它歸咎於冰厚並重新製備樣品，浪費兩輪顯微鏡時間。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Pushing a 700 Å virus to 3 Å without Ewald correction lets the two hemispheres' phases cancel, the map shows false attenuation beyond 3.7 Å, and the analyst blames ice thickness and re-prepares specimens, wasting two rounds of microscope time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：再往下是三階以上的像差：三重像散與四階球面像差在 2 Å 以下成為限制，需要以資料本身精修出的像差係數校正。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Beyond that, third-order and higher aberrations such as threefold astigmatism and fourth-order spherical aberration become limiting below 2 Å and need aberration coefficients refined from the data themselves.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「顆粒越大訊號越強，所以大顆粒總是更容易做到高解析度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Larger particles give more signal and are therefore always easier to push to high resolution." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 設施級整合：產出、液氮、資料量與即時處理：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Facility-level integration: throughput, nitrogen, data volume and on-the-fly processing: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「設施排程、液氮供應與資料管線」如何決定低溫電子顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。

steps.instruction: 國家級設施把顯微鏡當成全天候運轉的產線：自動載入器一次裝入十二片網格，自動收集軟體用像移在孔陣列間每幾秒拍一部電影，一天可產出數千部；液氮以自動補給系統連續供應樣品台、冷阱與載入器，中斷即造成樣品損失。資料流是另一個瓶頸：每部電影數十幀的 4k 影像未壓縮超過 1 GB，一天數 TB，必須在收集同時做漂移修正、CTF 擬合與顆粒挑選的即時處理，把回饋在數分鐘內送回操作者以決定是否更換網格。設施還要管理使用者培訓、網格篩選顯微鏡與高解析顯微鏡的分流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「設施排程、液氮供應與資料管線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A national facility runs the microscope as a round-the-clock production line: the autoloader holds twelve grids, automated software records a movie every few seconds across hole arrays by image shift, and thousands of movies are produced per day; liquid nitrogen is supplied continuously by an automatic refill system to stage, cryo-shield and loader, and any interruption costs specimens. Data flow is another bottleneck: a movie of tens of 4k frames exceeds 1 GB uncompressed, days reach several terabytes, and motion correction, CTF fitting and particle picking must run on the fly so that feedback reaches the operator within minutes to decide whether to swap grids. The facility also manages user training and the split between screening and high-resolution microscopes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Facility scheduling, nitrogen supply and data pipeline”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Data: one 4096×4096×16-bit frame = 33.5 MB, a 40-frame movie = 1.34 GB, 3000 per day = 4.0 TB/day; sparse counting formats or 8-bit gain-normalised compression cut this to roughly a tenth.

steps.title: 解析度驗證、標準樣品基準與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Resolution validation, standard-sample benchmarks and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「FSC 0.143 與去鐵蛋白基準」如何決定低溫電子顯微鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “FSC 0.143 and the apoferritin benchmark” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic electron microscopes”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重建解析度以黃金標準傅立葉殼相關（FSC）定義：把顆粒分成兩半獨立重建，兩圖在各空間頻率的相關降到 0.143 的頻率即為解析度，避免過擬合把雜訊當訊號。設施驗收用去鐵蛋白這類高對稱、高穩定的標準樣品：在規定的收集時間內達到 2 Å 以下證明顯微鏡、偵測器、製備與管線全部正常。交接文件要包含像素尺度與束傾校正、污染速率、偵測器 DQE、標準樣品的 ResLog 曲線與 B 因子、每日檢查清單，以及資料處理的參考流程，讓使用者能用同樣的程序判斷儀器狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「FSC 0.143 與去鐵蛋白基準」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruction resolution is defined by the gold-standard Fourier shell correlation (FSC): particles are split into two halves reconstructed independently, and the frequency where their correlation falls to 0.143 is the resolution, which prevents overfitting from passing noise off as signal. Facility acceptance uses a highly symmetric, stable standard such as apoferritin: reaching better than 2 Å within a specified collection time proves microscope, detector, preparation and pipeline all work. The handoff package must hold pixel-scale and beam-tilt calibrations, contamination rate, detector DQE, the standard sample's ResLog curve and B-factor, a daily checklist and a reference processing workflow so users can judge instrument state by the same procedure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “FSC 0.143 and the apoferritin benchmark”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：驗收門檻範例：去鐵蛋白在 4 小時收集內 FSC 0.143 ≤ 2.0 Å；ResLog 擬合的 B 因子 ≤ 80 Å²；像素尺寸校正不確定度 ≤ 0.3%；污染速率 ≤ 1 nm/h；束傾殘餘 ≤ 0.2 mrad；偵測器 DQE(0) ≥ 0.8；即時處理延遲 ≤ 5 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Example acceptance thresholds: apoferritin FSC 0.143 ≤ 2.0 Å within 4 hours of collection; ResLog-fitted B-factor ≤ 80 Å²; pixel-size calibration uncertainty ≤ 0.3%; contamination rate ≤ 1 nm/h; residual beam tilt ≤ 0.2 mrad; detector DQE(0) ≥ 0.8; on-the-fly latency ≤ 5 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「FSC 曲線上任何一點都能當解析度，門檻只是慣例。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any point on the FSC curve can serve as the resolution, the threshold being mere convention." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “FSC 0.143 and the apoferritin benchmark”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 解析度驗證、標準樣品基準與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Resolution validation, standard-sample benchmarks and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「FSC 0.143 與去鐵蛋白基準」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “FSC 0.143 and the apoferritin benchmark” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：驗收門檻範例：去鐵蛋白在 4 小時收集內 FSC 0.143 ≤ 2.0 Å；ResLog 擬合的 B 因子 ≤ 80 Å²；像素尺寸校正不確定度 ≤ 0.3%；污染速率 ≤ 1 nm/h；束傾殘餘 ≤ 0.2 mrad；偵測器 DQE(0) ≥ 0.8；即時處理延遲 ≤ 5 min。B 因子的意義：B = 80 Å² 時從 3 Å 到 2.5 Å 需 exp(40×(1/6.25 − 1/9)) ≈ 7.1 倍顆粒，B = 120 Å² 時需 19 倍，所以 B 因子直接換算成顯微鏡時間成本。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Example acceptance thresholds: apoferritin FSC 0.143 ≤ 2.0 Å within 4 hours of collection; ResLog-fitted B-factor ≤ 80 Å²; pixel-size calibration uncertainty ≤ 0.3%; contamination rate ≤ 1 nm/h; residual beam tilt ≤ 0.2 mrad; detector DQE(0) ≥ 0.8; on-the-fly latency ≤ 5 min. What the B-factor means: at B = 80 Å² going from 3 Å to 2.5 Å needs exp(40×(1/6.25 − 1/9)) ≈ 7.1 times the particles, at B = 120 Å² 19 times, so the B-factor converts directly into microscope-time cost. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以去鐵蛋白依標準流程收集 4 小時並以固定處理流程重建，報告 FSC 曲線、局部解析度圖與 ResLog；比對模型與圖的 FSC 0.5 解析度，確認與半圖 FSC 一致；每月重複一次作為效能趨勢，任何指標退化 10% 以上即觸發維護並回溯該期間的使用者資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Collect apoferritin for 4 hours by the standard protocol and reconstruct with a fixed workflow, reporting the FSC curve, local-resolution map and ResLog; compare the model-to-map FSC 0.5 resolution with the half-map FSC for consistency; repeat monthly as a performance trend, and a 10% degradation of any indicator triggers maintenance and a review of user data from the period.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 解析度驗證、標準樣品基準與工程交接：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「FSC 0.143 與去鐵蛋白基準」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “FSC 0.143 and the apoferritin benchmark” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以去鐵蛋白依標準流程收集 4 小時並以固定處理流程重建，報告 FSC 曲線、局部解析度圖與 ResLog；比對模型與圖的 FSC 0.5 解析度，確認與半圖 FSC 一致；每月重複一次作為效能趨勢，任何指標退化 10% 以上即觸發維護並回溯該期間的使用者資料。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Collect apoferritin for 4 hours by the standard protocol and reconstruct with a fixed workflow, reporting the FSC curve, local-resolution map and ResLog; compare the model-to-map FSC 0.5 resolution with the half-map FSC for consistency; repeat monthly as a performance trend, and a 10% degradation of any indicator triggers maintenance and a review of user data from the period. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：驗收只接受原廠一次性的去鐵蛋白 1.9 Å 結果而沒有 ResLog 與污染速率，三個月後使用者普遍只能到 3.5 Å，爭論究竟是樣品還是儀器，因為沒有基線而無法判斷。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Acceptance based on a single factory apoferritin result at 1.9 Å without ResLog or contamination rate leaves users three months later reaching only 3.5 Å and arguing whether sample or instrument is at fault, with no baseline to decide.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
